# designagent.dev

The site for one plugin: the designagent Figma bridge. Next.js 16 (App
Router) + Tailwind v4. Install commands come from
`.claude-plugin/marketplace.json`, which lists only the bridge. Long-form docs are MDX in
`content/plugins/`.

# Design spec (generated by DesignAgent — source of truth for UI)
@docs/DESIGN.md

The site is a single page (`app/page.tsx`) styled as the light version of
superdesigner.ai: Geist + Geist Mono, one giant tight headline, hairline rules,
white rounded tiles (`.card`) with a soft violet glow, black as the action color.
Tokens live in `app/globals.css`. `docs/DESIGN.md` above predates this look and
has not been regenerated; where they disagree, `globals.css` wins. Copy is
written for designers in plain language.
